descricao.en: A record label dedicated to sonic and visual experimentation. A collective space where different projects, identities, and sounds coexist. From heavy and distorted riffs to cold, ethereal synthscapes. Each project carries its own voice, its own narrative, and its own visual identity. An ongoing archive of experiments, a space where boundaries are tested and the only commitment is to the art of sound.

A brutal collision of Industrial Metal and Electro-Industrial. Built on heavy, mechanical drum machines, distorted synths, and abrasive textures, the project creates an oppressive and claustrophobic atmosphere. The vocals are purely screamed, distorted, and aggressive, with no room for clean vocals or melody. It is the sound of pure mechanical fury, where every track is a relentless assault of noise and aggression.

descricao.en: Dark science fiction universe where sound and narrative merge to create an immersive, fictional world. Every release, whether music, visual, or story, is a fragment of a larger interconnected mythos. Transmissions from the void. The signal never stops.

A brilliant hacker living in a world that was soon reduced to ashes. Discovered by the enemy and left to die with 80% of his body burned by the fire. Rescued and rebuilt with metal and wires by his best friend, he became a cyborg, half man, half machine. What remains is not just a survivor, but a man forged by tragedy, carrying the weight of a war that took everything from him. The sound is pure, raw heavy metal, thrash metal, and doom metal. It is built on pounding drums, heavily distorted guitars, and a powerful, gritty male vocal that shifts between three distinct registers: angry, aggressive screams; fragile, high-pitched wails of pain; and a classic thrash metal delivery. It is the sound of the fire that forged the man.
A short and powerful breath of resilience. Pure defiance against the ashes. The proof that even after the fire and the dark, the spark remains unquenched.

descricao.en: The cold revenge of hacking into the enemy's systems. The shock of the fire. The pain of being reconstructed piece by piece. The obsession with a machine that could change everything. The abandonment. And finally, the acceptance of a legacy born from ashes. A chronicle of destruction and survival.

The memory of a life before the war. The peace, the routine, and the quiet love shared in a world that was soon to be lost. It is the story of a world worth saving, and the creeping shadow that consumed it all.

The ruins of a love destroyed by forces beyond control. It narrates the heavy silence, the words left unsaid, and the impossibility of repairing what was broken. It is the agonizing choice of letting go of what mattered most.
A violent clash born from blind rage and a moment of regret. It traces the fragile journey from bitter rivalry to mutual respect, forging an unbreakable alliance against the coming storm.
The darkest chapter. The despair of being the last one standing. The loss of hope. And the final, desperate stand against the colonizer.

The crushing weight of a truth that cannot be unlearned. The suffocating guilt of every life touched, the shadow of every tragedy. It is the moment when the creator must face the absolute silence of his own making.

The embodiment of grief and unfulfilled love. An existence confined entirely within the confines of its own mind, mourning a loss that is as absolute as it is silent. The sonic identity blends gothic, darkwave, and post-punk with an ethereal, fragile female vocal, drenched in reverb and heavy with despair. It is the sound of the void left behind when someone leaves, a presence that lives entirely in the past because the present is too painful to inhabit.

A hymn to the unattainable. Not the pain of a breakup, but the agonizing devotion to someone who will never be yours. It explores the beauty found in ruin and the terrible preservation of a love that never existed.
A love that never blooms. A reverence for the inevitable end, caring for something that is already fading. Not to save it, but to honor its brief existence.

A journey of picking through the ashes, learning to unbecome the person built for someone else, and discovering that survival is not the same as healing.

descricao.en: The sound of surrender turned into peace. The search in the crowd ends with the acceptance of quiet. It is the conscious choice to let go, where silence is no longer a wound, but the only companion that stays. The peace is not found, but built brick by brick.

An act of emotional archaeology. A return to the places of grief, not to mourn, but to see what remains. It is the acceptance of the scars, the transformation of pain into something it can endure, and the quiet courage to close the gate and walk forward.

The time traveler who never wins. Originally just a man who believed in his best friend, he was forced into a temporal loop when he piloted a time machine to prevent the invasion. Trapped in a cycle where every failure resets the day and throws him into a different era or planet, he is the ultimate tragic hero. He knows the name of everyone who will die, he knows the exact second the bombs will fall, yet he never stops trying. He is the anchor of the universe, the thread that connects the timelines, even if he is doomed to always arrive too late. The sound is defined by dark synthwave, outrun, and retrowave. Cold, nocturnal, and cinematic, it features pulsating basslines and melancholic synths. The vocal delivery is robotic, tired, and spoken more than sung, reflecting a man who has repeated the same words a thousand times in the dark.

The beginning, before the war and the machine. The pure friendship forged long before the ashes. It covers the tragedy of the attack, the fire that consumed a friend, and the agonizing decision to leave them behind to step into the unknown. It is the origin of the guilt that will fuel an eternal cycle.
He carried the body through the flames. Not because he knew how to save him, but because letting go was not an option.

descricao.en: The same morning. The same cold coffee. The same impending doom. It is the purest form of exhaustion and paranoia, where a new plan is tried and fails, while a mysterious crack in the system offers a glimpse of something else.

An ancient desert civilization. A prophet of doom in a land that refuses to listen. The isolation of speaking a truth no one wants to hear, and the heavy burden of watching the inevitable unfold from a distance.

A space station, the first target before the world below. A claustrophobic and high-stakes attempt to hack the system and evacuate the innocent. It is the brutal dilemma of trying to buy time against a machine that fights back, knowing the station is destined to burn.

A quiet and melancholic return to the homeworld, before the fire. The heavy weight of allegiance and the desperate attempt to save a doomed world. It is the heartbreaking acceptance that the loop will eventually pull him away again, leaving only the realization that the war remains the same, and only the sky changes.

The scream in a world that chose silence. Living in a colonized urban center, reacting to the loss of identity and the oppressive surveillance state with pure, unadulterated rage. This is a refusal to be erased. descricao.en: The same morning. The same cold coffee. The same impending doom. It is the purest form of exhaustion and paranoia, where a new plan is tried and fails, while a mysterious crack in the system offers a glimpse of something else.

An ancient desert civilization. A prophet of doom in a land that refuses to listen. The isolation of speaking a truth no one wants to hear, and the heavy burden of watching the inevitable unfold from a distance.

A space station, the first target before the world below. A claustrophobic and high-stakes attempt to hack the system and evacuate the innocent. It is the brutal dilemma of trying to buy time against a machine that fights back, knowing the station is destined to burn.

A quiet and melancholic return to the homeworld, before the fire. The heavy weight of allegiance and the desperate attempt to save a doomed world. It is the heartbreaking acceptance that the loop will eventually pull him away again, leaving only the realization that the war remains the same, and only the sky changes.

The scream in a world that chose silence. Living in a colonized urban center, reacting to the loss of identity and the oppressive surveillance state with pure, unadulterated rage. This is a refusal to be erased. The anti-hero of the mundane, a man who sees the cameras, the propaganda posters, and the neighbors turning against each other, deciding to fight back with the only weapon he has: his voice. The sound is defined by post-punk and gothic rock, driven by a pulsating bass, angular guitars, and dry, urgent vocals. The music sounds like a protest shouted in a dark alley. Raw, tense, and confrontational, it captures the paranoia of a man who knows the history of oppression and recognizes it happening in real-time.

The awakening of a man who realizes his world has been subtly stolen. The shock of recognizing a surveillance regime gives way to the paranoia of feeling watched, and the painful memory of a time before the cameras. It is a journey from contained anger to the first act of physical resistance, embracing the heavy consequences of defying the system.
The world didn't change overnight. It changed while he was looking the other way. Now, his eyes are open.

descricao.en: The silence in a world that screams. Living in a dystopian, colonized urban center, she represents the psychological erosion caused by an oppressive regime. While the world reacts with anger, this is the slow, agonizing dissolution of identity. Suffering from memory loss and depersonalization, it is someone standing at their own front door, holding a key that no longer fits, wondering if they ever belonged there at all. The sound is defined by darkwave, coldwave, EBM, and minimal synthwave. Cold, hypnotic, and club-oriented, it is driven by pulsating basslines and atmospheric synths. The vocal delivery is dry, distant, and intimate, narrating the horror of looking into a mirror and not recognizing the face staring back. It is the sound of the void.

Fragmented memories of a past that might not be real. The terrifying void of recognizing familiar faces but feeling nothing. It culminates in front of a mirror that reflects nothing but the initial shock of losing oneself.

descricao.en: The terror seen from below. The agony of those who watched their world disappear. The panic of the first contact and the slow realization that the future has been erased.

The cold face of power. The resistance is dead. There is no need for violence or shouting anymore; the control is silent, calculated, and absolute. It is the reality of a regime that has won, where obedience is no longer a choice, but a program. Colder, quieter, and far more terrifying than the chaos of war.
The sound of extermination, without negotiation, only elimination. It is the raw violence of a species being wiped out, ending with the terrifying silence of a world where no one is left.

The slow, agonizing aftermath. The sound of survival when there is nothing left to live for. It explores the chronic pain, the exhaustion of grief, and the terrifying realization that the pain has become the only thing keeping you alive.
The horror of two distinct consciousnesses blending into a single, terrifying harmony of hatred and surrender.
The total annihilation of a world, discarded and broken. It is the silence that follows the end, where nothing remains but debris and the cold void left behind by a departing force.
The slow, empty pace of a journey through the void to the next world. It is cold, empty, and inevitable. The silence of the search, terminated by finding the next target.
